panels.description: Active sessions captured by sp_WhoIsActive. Respects the dashboard time range — all snapshots collected within the selected window are shown as individual rows (e.g. 2 sessions at 7:00 am + 3 sessions at 7:02 am = 5 rows). Rows are joined by session_id across metrics; the Prometheus scrape timestamp becomes the Collection Time column.
